rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Referent resolution under a sequential deck read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Sequential read of all 14 chunks (this session). Closest-to-violating candidates are both within-chunk forward pointers to the chunk's own immediately-following bullets: chunk 3 line 39 'The first two are about what you let in.' resolving against its own two bullets (41, 43), and chunk 4 line 47 'The rest are about what you do with the work once it's in front of you.' resolving against its own three bullets (49, 51, 53) — the whole chunk is one visual unit under projection, so this is not a cross-chunk forward reference. Chunk 7 line 73 'The rest fall into two kinds: durable problems you engineer around, and loud problems whose fix already shipped' names and defines both categories inline in the same sentence rather than gesturing at an undefined later referent, and chunk 8 line 81 'The other kind is loud but shrinking' reuses that same-file pairing (NOT-violation: term introduced on an earlier slide, reused). No pronoun/demonstrative anywhere points at a referent absent from the file up to that point, and none stays ambiguous holding full deck history.

`grep -niE '\bmodule\b|\bM[1-6]\b|\bexercise\b|\blecture\b'` against the body (lines 1-120, this session): zero hits. `grep -niE '\b(above|below|further down|top of this|further up)\b'`: one hit, line 5 'even far below the window's limit' — a numeric-scope preposition, not a positional cross-file pointer. No reference to another file by position or title anywhere in the body.

rules_evaluated.evidence: All 14 chunks carry a self-sufficient claim. Smallest is chunk 10 'One lever, two payoffs' (49 words, lines 91-94), a complete standalone summary ('Token efficiency is one lever with two payoffs... The rest is noticing what you loaded and never used.'), not a wait-state or single context-dependent bullet. Both Sources chunks (12-13) are self-carrying citation lists.

Checked all 13 `##` headers against their own chunk content. Closest candidate: chunk 8 header 'Drivers of inefficient context: the loud ones' (line 79) opens 'The other kind is loud but shrinking: it announces itself, and its fix usually already shipped' and both named drivers underneath cash that out (MCP overhead 'largely solved'; cache-bust 'a version-specific defect a later release patches') — header holds. No header is contradicted by its chunk's content ('More rules, worse edits' ch.5 delivers a rules-ceiling argument; 'Put a number on it' ch.2 delivers a dollar figure).

Per sub-item, grepped and read the full body (this session): 'Not X. Not Y. Z.' construction (`grep -nE 'Not [A-Z][a-z]+\.? *Not'`) — zero hits. Anaphora/epistrophe triples — zero hits (no 3+ repeated parallel clauses anywhere). Self-grading superlatives (`grep -niE 'one of the (most|best)'`) — zero hits. Number+own-retraction — the only 'about N' figures in-body (line 33 'about 10 dollars... 2 dollars'; line 89 'around fifteen times') are stated comparisons with their labels, not the hedge-then-undercut shape the rule's exception clause names ('about 10%... could be more, could be less'), which does not occur anywhere in this body. Abstraction-noun stacks and verb triplets with an empty leg — none found; the craft/drivers sections stay in concrete nouns (the files Claude didn't load, a messy repo, a bloated CLAUDE.md).
